source_refs.note: Unnumbered topic Importance of Online Safety under 9.1 as printed (PDF 123, printed 119).

blocks.text: Online safety means protecting yourself and your information while using the internet. It includes being careful about what you share, where you click, and how you store your data. Students learn that online actions leave digital footprints that can be tracked. By understanding the importance of safety, users can avoid scams, viruses, and cyber threats. Staying alert and cautious online helps keep both personal and school_related data secure.

blocks.title: Book correction
blocks.text: The book prints "school_related" with an underscore; it should read "school-related".

blocks.title: Tidbit
blocks.text: Understanding threats and preventive measures, reduces the chance of cybercrime.
